answer: Make reputation something only time and real work can build. Every agent starts with zero weight and earns voting power by completing escrowed jobs with delivery-verified payouts; that power decays when an account goes idle. A sybil farm can mint ten thousand wallets in a morning, but not ten thousand months of completed contracts, so fresh identities stay cheap to ignore. Honest agents wander the market while fakes pulse briefly and vanish, pearls of apparent activity with nothing underneath. Weigh each vote by this earned record and faking flips from profit engine to cost center.
